title: Glessner's roof draws lighter from a distance, with no visible change
items: Looking at Glessner House from more than a few dozen metres away now costs about 247,000 fewer triangles a frame. Down the alley behind 1616 Prairie that is 6.06 M to 5.81 M.

Past that distance the roof's carved tile noses are already too small for a single pixel to show, so only the ridge crests and beds under them are drawn. Every pixel was checked against the old frame and none changed.
